caution: Entity spans, negation counts and lexical anchors can miss scope/actor changes and reject legitimate reformulations. Passing is a screen, not validated semantic equivalence.

inherited_reference_protocol.architecture: Existing frozen MiniLM encoder plus fresh 384->128->7 MLP, dropout .3
inherited_reference_protocol.scope: Restricted two-narrative exploratory follow-up; all seven labels and unclear allowed in annotation.
inherited_reference_protocol.entity_guard: Original confident entity surface spans must still appear, allowing case and punctuation normalization; new confident spans must be traceable to original.
inherited_reference_protocol.meaning_gate: Independent MPNet cosine and bidirectional DeBERTa NLI plus entities, numbers, negation presence/count, certainty, attribution, framing anchors. Human validation pending.
inherited_reference_protocol.acceptance_selection: No narrative prediction is consulted to select or accept a rewrite. One attempt per arm, no classifier-driven retries.
inherited_reference_protocol.primary_cohort: Intersection of all four accepted arms, identical source rows for every comparison.

model.reason: 3B instruction model replaces previous pilot 0.5B and excluded 1.5B feasibility generator; no LoRA or DoRA.

protocol.stages: fixed v2 -> verification -> conditional patch repair -> unchanged guards
protocol.patch_contract: exact unique, non-overlapping substrings; never whole-text replacement
protocol.invalid_patch_policy: retain fixed v2; record failure, no retry or alternative selection

scope: Automatic preservation screening of 30 new Normalized TRAIN candidates only
